buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 4. Scope of Supply

Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 10. Past Project Experience The Bidder / OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)}, should have executed project for supply and installation / commissioning of same or similar Category Products during preceding 3 financial years (i.e. current year and three previous financial years) as on opening of bid, as per following criteria: (i) Single order of at least 35% of estimated bid value; or (ii) Two orders of at least 20% each of estimated bid value; or (iii) Three orders of at least 15% each of estimated bid value. Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid. In case of bunch bids, the Category related to primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED BID SPECIFIC TERMS & CONDITIONS Office of the Chief Engineer, Estate Management Department, WBSETCL invite s Two Packet Bid through GeM Portal for Supply, delivery & Installation of 01 (One) No. Laptop as per detailed specification mentioned in bid document from Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or their Author ized Resellers having past experience in similar work. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA OF THE BIDDERS

1. Bids are invited from Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or i ts Authorized Resellers. Following documents for meeting the pre-q ualification criteria should be uploaded along with techno- commerc ial offer of the bid otherwise their offer may be rejected: i. The tenderer should have either of the following as experience of ha ving successfully executed supply of same or similar Category Products in Govt., PSU or Public /Private Organization during current year and thr ee previous financial years as on opening of bid, as per following criteria : (a) Single order of at least Rs. 52,500/- being 35% of estimated bid val ue of Rs. 1,50,000/-including applicable taxes; or (b) Two orders of at least Rs. 30,000/- being 20% each of estimated bi d value Rs. 1,50,000/-including applicable taxes; or (c) Three orders of at least Rs. 22,500/- being 15% each of estimated bid value Rs. 1,50,000/-including applicable taxes. Here “similar category products” means “Supply, delivery & Inst allation of Laptops”. The Tenderer shall have to upload documents, v iz. order letters/LOA along with completion certificate (from credential is suing authority)/proof of execution of supply/delivery etc. along with TD S certificate including 26AS for validating the legitimacy of the completi on certificate etc. to establish his credentials. Note: The tenderer shall have to upload Copy of TDS certificate including 26 AS to validate the legitimacy of the completion cer tificate in support of successful executed supply of similar item s. ii. Must have Permanent A/c No, GST Registration Certificate & Valid Tra de License issued by a competent authority. (Certificates to be uploaded ). The Trade License should be pre-dated w.r.t the Bid Closing date & alig ned with criteria. 2. PRE-BID MEETING (20.11.2026 at 14:00 hours): Pre-bid meeting will be held at the Office of the Chief Engineer, Estate Management Department, th Vidyut Bhavan, 10 Floor D-Block, Salt Lake Sector-II, Kolkata-700091. No ex cuse of ignorance in this regard shall be accepted at a later date after the pre -bid meeting. In the event of making any important clarification or amendme nt of terms of the tender, pursuant to the discussion in the pre-bid meeting, th e same shall be immediately hosted in GeM Portal, for information of all conce rned and the same shall form a part of the Tender Document. No alteration sh all be made by the Tenderer in the tender document and the offer must be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the tender. For attending the Pre -bid Meeting, the representatives of the tenderers should accompany proper authorizations letters from their respective organizations. Any kind of commu nication after the pre-bid meeting will not be generally entertained. 3. SCOPE OF SUPPLY: (a) The scope includes supply, delivery & installation of One (01) No. Laptop with minimum three years on-site OEM warranty as per the detailed techn ical specification mentioned below: Parameters Mobile Computer Workstations: Model Specificatio ns Make HP / DELL Standard BIS Compliance standard ‘IS13252:2010’ (Mobile Worksta tion category) Processor th Intel Core i7 14 or better processor available in market

RAM Minimum 16GB DDR4 or higher version with support of sui table slots to expand memory up-to 32GB. Memory Size Minimum 1 TB SSD (Nvme) (Internal) Display Resolution 1920x1080 FHD display Battery Lithium-ion Battery Capacity (Watt Hour) - Minimum 36 Battery Backup Time (Hours) – 8 Chipsets Compatible chipsets as per processors make Display size 14" or Higher Display Type LED Bluetooth Enabled 5.0 or higher Wireless Device Wi-fi 6 or higher Ethernet 10/100/1000 on board integrated network port Interfaces RJ-45, Min. 2 USB3.0 Type A & 1 USB 3.0 Type C, Audio co mbo port, DC Adapter Jack, HDMI port Audio Built-in stereo speakers with high-definition audio support. Built-in Microphone. Hardware interface USB and HDMI Ethernet controllers Gigabit Ethernet Keyboard & touch pad dKeyboard with touch pad evice Mouse Optional Camera for viHD 720p Webcam deo conferencing OS Windows 11 Pro or latest version (Factory preloaded of OS ) Certification BIS, BEE, EPR, RoHS or any other relevant Indian Certificat es Laptop Bag As per OEM Warranty Minimum 3-years comprehensive (labour & spare- onsit e) OEM NBD (Next-Business-Day) support for all the lapt ops including battery and adaptor (b) The Bidder should mandatorily have support office in Kolkata for technic al support (call logging, call monitoring, call resolution etc.). (c) Information/issue/problem of any nature about any hardware/software p roblem of laptop would be reported to the successful bidder through e-mai l/ telephone number/official contact number (mobile) of the successful bid

der. Successful bidder thereafter would be responsible for logging the call t o the respective OEM and would monitor the same until the laptop becom es functional as per installed condition. The successful bidder shall resolve any hardware/software problem of the installed system within 72 hours fr om the time of lodging complaint through e-mail / telephone number / offi cial contact number (mobile) of the successful bidder. (d) The successful bidder shall be required to provide an Escalation Matrix ( Contact Numbers (Mobile), Contact Person Name & Email Addresses) of th e bidder. 4. WARRANTY: a. The successful bidder shall have to provide atl east three-years comp rehensive (labour & spare- onsite) OEM NBD (Next-Business-Day) support for all the laptops including battery and adaptor from the date of successf ul “Supply & Installation”. In this regard warranties / subscriptions should be provided as hard copies and be visible on website / portal of respective OEM. b. Information/issue/problem of any nature about any hardware/software p roblem of laptop would be reported to the successful bidder through e-mai l/ telephone number/official contact number (mobile) of the successful bid der. Successful bidder thereafter would be responsible for logging the call t o the respective OEM and would monitor the same until the laptop becom es functional as per installed condition. The successful bidder shall resolve any hardware/software problem of the installed system within 72 hours fr om the time of lodging complaint through e-mail / telephone number / offi cial contact number (mobile) of the successful bidder. c. The successful bidder shall be required to provide an Escalation Matrix (Contact Numbers (Mobile), Contact Person Name & Email Addresses) of t he bidder. d. The supplier must warrant all equipment, accessories, spare parts etc., against any manufacturing defects during the warranty period. 5. AVAILABILITY OF SERVICE CENTRES: During the warranty period the supplier shall maintain the equipment and repai r/ replace all the defective components at the installed site at no additional char ge of whatsoever nature to the Office of the Chief Engineer, Estate Management Department, WBSETCL, Kolkata. Bidder/OEM should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Trainin g, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in city of Kolkata, West Be ngal for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centers are to be uploaded along with the bid. 6. NON-RETURN OF HARD DISK: As per Buyer organization’s Security Policy, Faulty Hard Disk of Servers/Desktop Comp uters/ Laptops etc. will not be returned back to the OEM/supplier against warranty replaceme nt. 7. PERIOD OF VALIDITY OF OFFERS: Bid offered shall remain valid for evaluation for at least 120 days from the o pening date of Techno Commercial Bid. 8. TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE: Bidder should provide bid specific technical compliance as per format mention ed at Annexure-A of Bid document. The respective OEM shall duly certify this document (Annexure-A) for compliance. Annexure-A of bid document duly cer tify by OEM is to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. AUTHORITY IN SIGNING THE DOCUMENTS FOR SUBMISSION OF TENDER / O FFER: All documents to be uploaded by the bidder should be signed under official seal by – i. In case the Tender is submitted by a Proprietorship Firm, the same should b e signed either by Proprietor or other person, holding a valid Power of Attorne y from the Proprietor, in connection with this Tender. The signature of such Po wer of Attorney holder should be attested by the Proprietor. Such Power of Att orney should be uploaded along with Bid. In case the Bid is signed by a Proprietor of a Proprietorship Firm, Power of Att orney would not be required.

ii. In case the Tender is submitted by Partnership Firm, the same should be si gned either by partner(s), holding valid Power of Attorney from the partners o r other person(s), holding valid Power of Attorney from the partners, in conne ction with this Tender. The signature of such Power of Attorney holder should be attested by the partner(s). Such Power of Attorney should be uploaded alo ng with Bid. iii. In case the Tender is submitted by a Limited Company, the same should be s igned by person holding valid Power of Attorney executed in his favor (in conn ection with this Tender) and the signature of such Power of Attorney holder sh ould also be attested in accordance with the constitution of the Limited Comp any. Such Power of Attorney should be uploaded along with Bid. 10. OEM (ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER) AUTHORIZATION For authorized Reseller/ Dealer intending to submit the bid, they must submit Current Valid Unconditional Authorization Certificate, certifying bidder as aut horized reseller of OEM issued by the principal i.e. OEM for participation in thi s specific bid. 11. NON-RESPONSIVE OFFER: (a) During techno-commercial evaluation of tender, an offer shall be considered non-responsive in case of non-submission of the follo wing ‘Essential’ documents or non-fulfilment of following criteria: i. It does not meet the pre-qualification criteria as stipulated in the bid docume nt. ii. It is not accompanied by OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) auth orization certificate, as per clause mentioned in Bid document iii. It is not accompanied by Power of Attorney, as per applicable clause of Bid docu ment. (b) In addition to the above, a bidder may be disqualified, even th ough the bidders meet the above qualifying criteria, if: i. The bidder submits conditional offer / impose own terms and conditio ns / does not accept tender conditions completely / offer or tender if sub mitted with any deviation from the tender terms &conditions. ii. If the offer validity is less than 120 days (One hundred and twenty day s) from the opening date of Bid. iii. All the documents required as per tender are not uploaded or not submi tted, even after asked for as shortfall documents as the case may be. iv. A bidder may be disqualified if the bidder provides misleading or false information/representation in the forms, statements and attachments upl oaded/submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and necessary action will be taken as per Terms & Conditions of tender. v. Not accompanied with bid documents not signed, sealed and submitt ed in the manner indicated in the bid document. 12. PRICE BID: a) Price quoted by the tenderer shall remain fixed and valid until completion o f the contract and will not be subject to variation on any account, except stat utory levies for which documentary evidence is to be submitted. b) Price Bid should be FREE FROM ANY EXTRANEOUS CONDITION. 13. EVALUATION CRITERIA i) Provided that the bidder meets the tender terms and conditions, the overall low est offer shall be considered for acceptance by the WBSETCL. ii) Only such bids, as determined to be substantially responsive to the require ments of the bid documents will be evaluated. Other non- responsive bids will be rejected. WBSETCL’s decision on this shall be final, conclusive and binding. Bidder shall submit their offer for all the items/ or for any one of the items. Th e evaluation for award of tender will be on the basis of overall “L1” basis. iii) To assist in the examination, evaluation and comparison of bids, WBSETCL may ask bidders, individually for clarification of their bid. The request for clarif ication and the response shall be sent through E-mail of Estate Management Department, WBSETCL, but no change in price or substance of the bid shall b e sought, offered or permitted. 14. REJECTION OF TENDER DOCUMENTS Bidder is expected to examine the Tender documents including all instruction forms, terms, and specifications in Tender documents. Failure to furnish the i

nformation required as per the Tender Documents or submission of e-tender not substantially responsive to the tender Documents in every respect may r esult in the rejection of the tender. 15. BIDDERS RESPONSIBILITY TO SATISFY HIS QUERIES The Bidder may visit and inspect the site on his own responsibility and obtain all information that may be necessary for the purpose of his tender offer. No excuse of ignorance as to site conditions and local information will be accepte d in the event of his not visiting the site/ other equipment. All costs, charges a nd expenses that may be incurred by the Bidder in connection with the prepar ation of his tender shall be borne by him and the WBSETCL accept no liability whatsoever in this regard. 16. CLARIFICATION OF TENDER DOCUMENTS Prospective bidder requiring further information or clarification of the Tender Documents may notify in writing by e-mail in the given e-mailing address indi cated below for tenders within a reasonable time prior to the time of submissi on of tender. Email: emdwbsetcl@gmail.com 17. AMENDMENT OF TENDER DOCUMENTS: a) At any time prior to the deadline for submission of tenders, the Officials for any reason whether at his own initiative or in response to a clarification requir ed by a prospective Bidder may modify the Tender Documents. b) For any and all amendments, if any, of the instant tender, such amendment s will be hoisted in GeM portal only and no further notification will be made. A ccordingly interested bidders are advised to keep close GeM Portal https://ge m.gov.in/ in their own interest. c) It is also to be noted that any such amendment will be a part of the instant tender document and will be binding on the bidder and it will be presumed th at the bidder has satisfied himself about such amendments hoisted in GeM Po rtal for the amendment, if any as corrigendum will be binding on the prospec tive Bidders. 18. SPECIAL INSTRUCTION: a) In a tender, either the Indian agent on behalf of the principal / O.E.M or Prin cipal / O.E.M itself can bid but both cannot bid simultaneously for the same it em / product in the same tender. b) If any agent submits bid on behalf of the Principal / O.E.M, the same agent s hall not submit a bid on behalf of another Principal / O.E.M in the same tender for the same item /product. 19. OPENING OF TENDERS: i. The Tender will be opened online. Bidder can see the technical bid and price by ac cessing their login id once opened. ii. To assist in the examination, evaluation and comparison of tenders, evaluat ion department may, at his/her discretion, ask the Bidder for a clarification of their offer. All responses to requests for clarification shall be in writing and no change in the price or substance of the tender shall be permitted. iii. The Tender will be evaluated by WBSETCL and only those offers which are substa ntially responsive to the specifications will be short listed. Further processing, discu ssion, etc. will be held only with the short-listed Bidders. iv. A bidder may be disqualified if the bidder provides misleading or false informatio n in the statements and documents submitted and, in that event, the said bidder m ay be debarred for a specified time from participation in the tender forfeited. 20. RIGHT TO ACCEPT ANY TENDER OR REJECT ANY OR ALL OFFERS: WBSETCL reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and/or part thereof , without assigning any reason. Estate Management Department, WBSETCL re serves the right to annul the tendering process and reject all the tenders at an y time prior to award of contract, without thereby incurring any liability to the affected Bidders or any obligations to inform the affected Bidders the reason for such actions. 21. NOTIFICATION OF AWARD:

WBSETCL may notify the successful Bidder in writing or by email to be confir med in writing that their offer has been accepted. 22. DELIVERY LOCATION: Materials shall be delivered including unloading by successful bidder at their own cost, risk and responsibility at the Consignee location(s) as mentioned in bid document. 23. DELIVERY SCHEDULE: The successful bidder shall have to supply, deliver & install all items as per bill of quantity within 30 days from the date of placement of contract. 24. PACKING OF MATERIALS: Material will be packed by successful bidder at t heir own responsibility at their own cost and arrangement for protection again st any damage, loss, breakage or leakage etc. 25. DISPATCH ARRANGEMENTS: The supplier shall be fully responsible for an y transit loss or damage to the materials. The supplier shall send advance inti mation as to the actual date of delivery of each and every installment of supp ly. Delivery of materials will not be accepted on Saturday, Sundays and the H olidays of WBSETCL. The authorized representative of the suppliers should be present at the time of delivery for jointly noting with the representative of Est ate Management Department the discrepancies, if any, regarding the particul ars of materials actually delivered against the challans for the same. Delivery will not be accepted if not accompanied with proper delivery challans and oth er related documents like inspection certificates, etc. Suppliers need to arran ge themselves for the same through latest online portal. 26. REJECTION OF MATERIALS: a) Notwithstanding the inspection and passing of materials by authorize d person of the department, any material found to be defective in quality and not conforming to the relevant specification, shall liable to be rejected and th e supplier shall replace the same at his cost and arrangement at the earliest. b) The supplier shall at his own arrangement and cost replace within a p eriod of 1 (one) month of all such defective and rejected materials. c) Rejected materials shall be at Supplier’s risk. They must be collected f rom the department within a fortnight from the date of rejection on observin g usual procedure on the matter. If the contractor fails to remove such materi als, the department shall have the right to dispose of the same and the suppli er shall have no claim against the department in respect of the said rejected materials. 27. PAYMENTS TERMS: a) 100% of the order value will be released in due course against you r bill (in triplicate) along with signed Challan in original, installation r eport & Warranty Certificate as per Warranty Clause. No Advance Pay ment will be made under any Circumstances days from the date of pl acement of contract. b) The payment against product upon supply, delivery, installation, commissio ning & final acceptance of the equipment by the End User / Consignee and on submission of bill accompanied with stamped & signed copy of successful com missioning by End User or with Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate ( CRAC) generated through the GeM portal. c) The payment shall be credited to your bank account through NEFT/RTGS m echanism within 30 (Thirty) days from the date of submission of the bill. 28. INCOME TAX DEDUCTION Deduction of Income Tax shall be made from any amount payable to the Cont ractor as per the relevant provisions of the Income Tax Act. 29. TDS UNDER GST LAW: Tax shall be deducted under GST law as per prevailing rate. 30. L. D. Clause – a) Delivery of the ordered articles in stipulated delivery period is an essence o f the contract. However, in case of delayed delivery Liquidated damage @ 0

.25% of the ordered value per week or part thereof, subject to maximum of5 % will be imposed and that will be deducted from the bill of the Vendor. b) Conditional / incomplete tender will not be accepted under any circumstances. c) Tender submitted after expiry of scheduled date & time will not be considered. d) WBSETCL reserves the right to accept or reject the bid, wholly or partly, or t o split the work in parts and to add / delete any of the items, without assigning any reasons whatsoever. 31. CONDITIONAL DISCOUNT: Evaluation of tenders will not be made on conditional discount if any offered by the bidder. 32. BID CURRENCY: Price shall be quoted in INR only. 33. Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if they do not upload any of the ce rtificates /documents sought in the bid document, ATC and corrigendum if an y If conditions above are not strictly complied with. 34. GOOD CONDUCT CLAUSE: If a bidder has had previous history of “de fined misconduct “(such as banning from by any government sector, premat ure termination of a contract solely on the bidder’s fault, criminal case pendi ng against the company or its owner /current director filed by a government entity etc.) his offer is liable to be ignored. 35. INSPECTION AND TESTING: Inspection of materials shall be done by Estate Management Departments’ authorized officer after delivery of materi al at the Consignee's address. The materials to be supplied by the supplier s hould strictly conform to the laid down specification of tender / order. If and when necessary, samples from the supplies may be drawn and the same will be tested by Estate Management Department’s authorized person and if foun d to be inferior to the laid down specifications of tender / order, the materials will be rejected in whole or in part and supplier shall be debited with the cost of test and rejected materials shall be replaced by the supplier at his own cos t and arrangement. 36. In the event of any unforeseen closure of work/holiday on any of the a bove days the same will be opened/ held on the next working day without an y further notice. 37. Please upload duly filled and signed copy of Annexure-A (Descr iption & Specification of Laptop), Form-1 (Expressed undertaking by the Bid der), Form-2 (General Particulars of the tenderer), Form-3 (Bank Partic ulars of the bidder), Annexure-B (Check list) along with bid. 38. TAX CLAUSE · For Tax inclusive contracts Prices or fees quoted in the offer by the bidd er shall be inclusive of GST and/or other statutory Levies, taxes, cess impo sed by Competent Authorities unless otherwise provided. · Any new statutory levies, taxes, duties, cess, etc. imposed by the Centr al / State / local authorities by way of fresh notification subsequent to the issue of work Order / Purchase Order, but within the stipulated delivery p eriod shall be paid extra. · Any additional cost or benefit impacting the contract price resulting fro m introduction of any new law, towards leviable taxes, including eligible cr edits, in respect of goods and services to be supplied under the Contract, t hen the Parties agree to an adjustment to the contract price to reflect the financial impact of such “Change in law”. · WBSETCL has the right to recover monetary loss including interest and penalty suffered by it due to any non-compliance of tax laws by the suppli er/service provider. Any loss of input tax credit to WBSETCL for the fault o f supplier shall be recovered by WBSETCL by way of adjustment in the co nsideration payable. · The purchase order work order shall be void, if at any point of time you are found to be a black listed dealer as per GSTN rating system and furth er no payment shall be entertained. 39.
